text:
Maya (eng-infra): Heads-up — I'm seeing the gpu-nodegroup GitOps reconcile flip/flap after the midnight infra push. Terraform apply hangs waiting on nodegroup update and CNI pods in eu-west-2a can't attach ENIs. Anyone seen this pattern?
Sam K: Ugh, saw a couple alerts but didn't dig in. Is this the new mixed-az affinity change we rolled yesterday?
Jordan L: I grabbed logs from one of the failing nodes, looks like the aws-cni is spamming attach errors.
Jordan L: ```
ERROR: ENI allocation failed: not enough free addresses in subnet (subnet-0a1b2c3d)
```
Maya (eng-infra): Exactly. Our autoscaler spun up 4 spot GPU nodes in 2a, but the subnet there is small (leftover from old cluster test) — IP exhaustion + CNI upgrade ordering seems to trigger the reconcile loop.
infra-bot: :warning: aws-enis-low - 2a subnet free-ip-count=3 (threshold=5)
Sam K: Which part is hanging Terraform? plan -> apply -> waiting on aws_autoscaling_group.provisioner?
Maya (eng-infra): Plan output: "aws_eks_node_group.gpu: Modifying..." then it stalls on creating launch template because the GitOps helm release for aws-node changed the eks-pod-eni config at the same time. It looks like GitOps updated addon values before nodegroup finished reprovisioning.
Jordan L: That ordering race would leave some nodes with the old CNI config, others with the new; mixed behavior = some pods can't attach. Also saw kubelet taint/label differences: new nodes get zoneAffinity label set by module, existing don't. Scheduler packs pods into 2a which has smallest subnet.
Sam K: Short term mitigation: cordon and drain newly provisioned spot nodes in 2a, scale nodegroup to force new nodes into larger subnets? Risky but can buy time.
Maya (eng-infra): Trying a safer approach: pause GitOps for the aws-node addon so it doesn't flip values during nodegroup operations. Then re-run terraform apply to complete LT creation.
Jordan L: Commands I've been running: 
```
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide | grep aws-node
kubectl describe pod aws-node-xxxxx -n kube-system
```
Sam K: We should also fix the IaC ordering: split the gitops repo so nodegroup/ASG changes are applied before addon Helm charts for CNI. Add a post-apply gate in the pipeline that waits for node readiness + ENI capacity check.
Maya (eng-infra): Agreed. I'll open a quick RFC but in the meantime I'll pause the helm release rollout in the gitops PR and request an emergency subnet resize with infra team (increase cidr allocation for eu-west-2a or add secondary).
deploy-bot: Deployment blocked: helm/aws-node (eu-west-2) — paused by Maya (eng-infra)
Jordan L: Also tagging as action item: update nodegroup module to preserve labels/taints during rolling update, and avoid toggling zoneAffinity flag in the same push that changes LT. That will reduce churn.
Sam K: +1. After we finish the short-term fixes let's add a CI check: terraform plan must not touch nodegroup launch_template+labels in the same diff as addon values. Reject otherwise.
Maya (eng-infra): Putting notes in the incident ticket. Will coordinate subnet change with cloud ops and re-run apply once helm is paused. If anyone is free pls help with the drain -> scale sequence later tonight. :pray:
Jordan L: Happy to help.
infra-bot: Incident ticket created: INF-2026-4723 — "ENI exhaustion during nodegroup/CNI concurrent rollout"
Maya (eng-infra): Thanks all, will update thread after cloud ops confirms subnet expansion.
